change: Future shard processes use 768 MiB SQLite page cache instead of 256 MiB
reason: Observed long build wall times as bodies/indexes grow; a larger cache is a bounded IO-pressure experiment, not an established cause or speedup claim
threads: Still two CPU worker processes, affinity 6/12, zero SQLite auxiliary workers
batch: Unchanged 64 rows and <=2 GiB Arrow output batches; process RSS is separately measured
semantics: No source selection, tier, text, supplement, codec, FTS token policy or reader change
running_shards: 000_00000 and 000_00001 keep their already-loaded producer and 256 MiB cache; completed assets are not changed
provenance: Each shard captures producer source hashes at process start. Initial dispatcher commit describes the parent; actual child source hashes distinguish this resource-only change.
